protocol.previous_goal_turn: progress: v2 rejected on full ON/OFF gate; original-source IPO-only control reproduces large OFF regressions; old candidate and data retained. Original v2 deadline was missed, unchanged.
protocol.variant: v3c: specialize the same hot-region source once at entry for existing D087 completely unmetered execution (SIZE_MAX frame budget and NULL shared budget). Retain exact finite/shared accounting in the metered specialization, local cursor and immutable block span, shared call refactor and IPO in both JIT modes.
protocol.evidence: IPO-only versus refactor+IPO differs <1% on heap-sort/dijkstra. Three full-size sampling runs each put 95-99% exclusive samples in vm_hot for both binaries. Per-op frame cursor memory traffic is the selected intervention; sampling alone does not prove the exact machine-level cause.
protocol.early_gate: After focused fuel/root/exit/allocator tests, 3 warmups+11 paired unchanged heap-sort/dijkstra/title-search-100k/bfs-int versus accepted OFF: each median <=1.02 baseline and geometric mean latency reduction >=10%. The existing call target also remains: DSU/stack ON geometric mean latency reduction >=15%. Reject/rework if these fail.
protocol.full_gate: Both ON/OFF all32 unchanged workloads,114 input hashes, original stdout/args,64MiB. Median >2% or P90 >5% receives one confirmation; same metric repeated rejects. Nonincreasing sum of medians in both modes.
protocol.validation: Full ON/OFF tests, all32 correctness under ASan/UBSan and x86 Rosetta plus focused tests, all reachable deterministic allocation failures and both zero ledgers. Architecture/memory/roadmap/doc/spec/generated gates. No builds/tests/profilers during acceptance timings.
protocol.limits: Local candidate acceptance only; whole Go/Rust parity and Tier1/Linux LSan remain open; JIT remains opt-in. Native/Go/Rust/Bun comparison only after accepted full gate.
protocol.preceding_variant: v3b: 7.71% early geometric mean reduction, below unchanged10% gate. Rejected and preserved. V3a:7.07%. The original v3 deadline and both early/full gates remain unchanged.

native_comparator_binary_identity.method: Resolve each workload command executable in its own pinned binary metadata. Shared catalogue executables appear in multiple workload rows; the changing VM compiler is excluded.

deadline_scope: Evidence preparation time; actual commit/push time is recorded separately in publication.json.
limits: Local implementation acceptance; JIT remains OFF by default.
Full all32 Go/Rust parity, Linux LeakSanitizer and complete Tier1 validation remain open.
macOS ASan uses detect_leaks=0; Rosetta proves local x86 correctness, not physical x86 timing.
Sampling observes partial executions; function attribution alone does not prove a specific machine-level stall.
The prior v2 deadline was missed and is retained. Both rejected v3 early variants retain the same final-v3 deadline.
Host isolation is local-unverified; all full matrices, flags and required confirmations are retained.
